title: Persistence
description: Practices for durable, crash-safe local state.

practices.title: Atomic writes
practices.statement: Write to a temporary file, then atomically rename; never overwrite in place.

practices.title: Fsync before claiming durability
practices.statement: Do not claim durability without fsync of the data and, where required, the containing directory.

practices.title: Design for crash anywhere
practices.statement: Design for recovery from interruption at every write step, then test it.

practices.title: Detect corruption
practices.statement: Check checksums or structure on load; corrupted state is quarantined, not trusted.

practices.title: Version stored formats
practices.statement: Persisted formats carry a version and a migration path.
